target_name: The GEO Group, Inc. Political Action Committee
summary: GEO 2025 state/local GEO PAC total of $61,500 exactly matches gross-positive Schedule B payments in Arizona, Oklahoma, and Pennsylvania; signed net is $56,000 after $5,500 of negative adjustments.
detail: GEO official 2025 State / Local table reports GEO PAC amounts of $43,000 in Arizona, $17,500 in Oklahoma, and $1,000 in Pennsylvania. C00382150 Schedule B line-29 rows contain the same positive jurisdiction totals. Three Arizona negatives total $3,000 and one Oklahoma negative is $2,500, leaving signed net of $56,000. The result establishes the gross-positive convention for this 2025 table only.
